name: alertable_io_internal
declaration: unsafe fn alertable_io_internal (& self , io : impl FnOnce (& mut c :: OVERLAPPED , c :: LPOVERLAPPED_COMPLETION_ROUTINE) -> c :: BOOL ,) -> io :: Result < usize >
documentation:
Synchronizes asynchronous reads or writes using our anonymous pipe.

 This is a wrapper around [`ReadFileEx`] or [`WriteFileEx`] that uses
 [Asynchronous Procedure Call] (APC) to synchronize reads or writes.

 Note: This should not be used for handles we don't create.

 # Safety

 `buf` must be a pointer to a buffer that's valid for reads or writes
 up to `len` bytes. The `AlertableIoFn` must be either `ReadFileEx` or `WriteFileEx`

 [`ReadFileEx`]: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/fileapi/nf-fileapi-readfileex
 [`WriteFileEx`]: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/fileapi/nf-fileapi-writefileex
 [Asynchronous Procedure Call]: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/sync/asynchronous-procedure-calls
rules: `self` must refer to a pipe handle created by this implementation; this API must not be used with handles it did not create.
The `buf` pointer used by the I/O operation supplied through `io` must point to a buffer valid for reads or writes up to `len` bytes.
The I/O function used by `io` must be either `ReadFileEx` or `WriteFileEx`.
